j.vco1_shape.init: VCO 1’s SHAPE MOD is at 0, so nothing here moves the shape. Turn it up.

j.vco1_fm1.init: VCO 1’s FM 1 knob is at 0, so nothing here moves its pitch. Turn it up.

j.vco1_fm2.init: VCO 1’s FM 2 knob is at 0, so nothing here moves its pitch. Turn it up.

j.vco2_shape.init: VCO 2’s SHAPE MOD is at 0, so nothing here moves the shape. Turn it up.

j.vco2_fm1.init: VCO 2’s FM 1 knob is at 0, so nothing here moves its pitch. Turn it up.

j.vco2_fm2.init: VCO 2’s FM 2 knob is at 0, so nothing here moves its pitch. Turn it up.

j.aux.init: AUX LEVEL is at 0, so nothing patched here is heard. Turn it up.

j.vcf_fm1.init: The VCF’s FM 1 knob is at 0, so nothing here moves the cutoff. Turn it up.

j.vcf_fm2.init: The VCF’s FM 2 knob is at 0, so nothing here moves the cutoff. Turn it up.

j.vca_am1.vca.am1=0: The VCA’s AM 1 knob is at 0, so nothing here opens the VCA. Turn it up.

j.vca_am2.init: The VCA’s AM 2 knob is at 0, so nothing here opens the VCA. Turn it up.
